Fragment of a Latin inscripton relating to building works

Coarse-grained, homogeneous, grey, calcitic, smelly marble, likely Proconnesian. Optical microscopy: heteroblastic fabric with triple points. Digital microscopy: heteroblastic fabric (identification based on pXRF, digital microscopy, XRD, optical microscopy)
